import { Component, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; @Component({ selector: 'app-preloader', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule], templateUrl: './preloader.component.html', styleUrl: './preloader.component.scss', }) export class PreloaderComponent implements OnInit { isHidden = signal(false); ngOnInit() { setTimeout(() => { this.isHidden.set(true); }, 2500); } }
